title: release-engineering-meeting-notes-2026-07-21
content:
Attendees: Ethan Park (owner), Maya Chen, Liam O'Connor, Sofia Martinez, Arjun Rao, Claire Ng (notes).

Agenda:
- Quick sync on release train v1.12 (target prod: 2026-07-23)
- Hotfix status for 1.11.3 (prod incident earlier this week)
- Changelog highlights + doc updates
- Canary rollout plan and metrics to watch
- Action items and owners

Summary:
- v1.12 is feature-complete for the train. CI/CD green except for one flaky e2e failing on Windows runners (RE-4578). We will proceed with a staggered canary on 2026-07-23 with automatic rollback conditions defined.
- Hotfix 1.11.3 (RE-4521) deployed to prod on 2026-07-20 to address a KV-cache eviction bug causing elevated tail latency. Initial rollout (10% traffic) showed reduced p99 by ~120ms; full rollout completed 2026-07-21 03:15 UTC. No user-facing errors reported.

Notes / Discussion:
1) Release train v1.12
- Contents: batching improvements, improved kernel selection heuristic, observability tags for request routing.
- Blockers: flaky e2e (Windows env) tracked in RE-4578 — test team to triage; not a blocking issue for Linux-backed prod.
- Docs: release notes draft at Confluence link; need final review from product for wording on kernel change.
- Rollout plan: canary 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% over ~6h windows. Canary windows + metric checks defined in runbook.

2) Hotfix 1.11.3 recap
- Root cause: race in KV cache eviction + corner-case in async GC path. Fix: serialized eviction path and added guard. Patch PR: github PR #1284.
- Monitoring: CPU and GPU utilization stable; tail latency p99 improved. No regression detected in embeddings path.
- Follow-up: add targeted unit tests for eviction race (owner: Arjun Rao, due: 2026-07-28).

3) Canary metrics and SLO gates
- Primary metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, error-rate (5xx), request success rate, unit-cost delta.
- Canary gates: if p99 increases > 10% for 2 consecutive windows OR 5xx > 0.5% -> auto-rollback.
- Synthetic workload: use perf harness job release-canary-2026-07-23 to simulate mixed-length traffic. Liam to run a pre-canary run and post results to Slack channel #releases.

4) Change log items to highlight
- Batching heuristic (improved throughput for short sequences) — call out expected cost reduction in docs.
- Kernel selector update — mention compatibility notes for some quantized variants.
- Observability: request-routing tags + new trace fields.

5) Risk / Mitigations
- Risk: kernel selector change could affect a small set of edge quantized models. Mitigation: default to previous selector for pinned model versions; migrations opt-in.
- Risk: canary window too short for low-volume routes. Mitigation: extend window for routes with <100r/s to 12h sampling.

Action items:
- Maya: finalize release notes and ping product for wording approval (due 2026-07-22).
- Liam: run pre-canary perf harness and post results to #releases (due 2026-07-22 morning).
- Arjun: add unit/integration tests for KV eviction race and link PR to RE-4521 (due 2026-07-28).
- Sofia: update runbook with canary gates and rollback playbook edits (due 2026-07-22).
- Ethan: coordinate calendar blackout for 2026-07-23 canary and standby pager rotation (assign Claire as backup).

Decisions made:
- Proceed with v1.12 canary on 2026-07-23 despite Windows e2e flaky — not blocking for prod (decision: unanimous).
- Hotfix 1.11.3 will be considered closed once Arjun's tests are merged and smoke run passes for 48h.

Open / Parking lot:
- Consider automated detection for model-compatibility when kernel selector changes are introduced (longer-term, engineering project).
- Follow-up postmortem for last week's brief latency spike scheduled if needed after 72h of stability.

References / Links:
- JIRA RE-4521 (hotfix), RE-4578 (flaky test)
- GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood/serving-runtime/pull/1284
- Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RE/Release+Runbook+v1.12

Next meeting: weekly cadence — next sync 2026-07-28 10:00am PT.

Notes prepared by Claire Ng (notes ownership), reviewed by Ethan Park.
